skill.name: quiz-generator
skill.description: Generate 50-question interactive course quizzes for a Quiz component. The skill guides conceptual question writing, answer distribution, option-length checks, source attribution, and final validation.
skill.summary: Creates interactive 50-question course quizzes with balanced answers and feedback.
skill.author: 92Bilal26

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, quiz validation wording, and the word keys in distribution reporting. I confirmed that the local redistribution scripts overwrite the user-supplied quiz file, and SKILL.md instructs agents to run those scripts through Bash. No prompt injection, data exfiltration, or network behavior was found.

remediation.issue: Redistribution scripts overwrite the supplied quiz path.
remediation.suggestion: Add a dry-run mode, create a backup by default, and restrict writes to expected quiz Markdown files.

remediation.issue: The skill asks agents to run local Bash commands from a community package.
remediation.suggestion: Require user confirmation before execution and document exactly which files the script reads and writes.

content.value_statement: Course authors need balanced quizzes that test understanding instead of memorization. This skill creates 50-question Quiz component assessments with feedback, source links, and answer distribution checks.
actual_capabilities: Drafts 50-question conceptual quiz banks for end-of-chapter assessments.
Formats output for the local Quiz component with four options per question.
Guides immediate feedback explanations that address correct and incorrect options.
Uses bundled scripts to redistribute correct answers across indexes.
Applies checklists for option length, source fields, and JSX syntax.
limitations: Requires accurate course material from the user or repository.
Designed for interactive Quiz component files, not plain static quizzes.
Option length and explanation quality still need human review.
Redistribution scripts overwrite the target quiz file when run.

use_cases.title: Build Chapter Assessments
use_cases.description: Create a full 50-question quiz from lesson notes, with conceptual questions and source labels.

use_cases.title: Normalize Answer Distribution
use_cases.description: Rebalance correct answer positions so students cannot guess from simple patterns.

use_cases.title: Prepare Quiz Documentation
use_cases.description: Format a quiz for a documentation site that uses the Quiz component.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Chapter Quiz
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with one chapter and clear lesson notes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use quiz-generator to create a 50-question interactive quiz for this chapter. Focus on conceptual questions and include source labels.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Question Quality
prompt_templates.scenario: Refine an existing draft before formatting.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this quiz draft for recall-heavy questions. Rewrite weak items as applied scenarios with four balanced options.

prompt_templates.title: Balance Answers and Feedback
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a quiz for final review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this quiz for answer distribution, option length bias, and explanation coverage. Identify every item that needs revision.

prompt_templates.title: Run Full Handoff Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Validate a completed course quiz before publishing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the full quiz-generator checklist to this file. Report coverage gaps, formatting issues, explanation risks, and redistribution steps.

output_examples.input: A chapter on Python mutability with lesson titles and notes.
output_examples.output: A 50-question interactive assessment with conceptual scenarios, immediate feedback, and source labels for each lesson.

output_examples.input: An existing quiz with uneven correct-answer positions.
output_examples.output: A revised quiz workflow plan that redistributes answers, checks explanations, and reports validation items.

output_examples.input: A course module that needs final quality review.
output: Coverage gaps noted for missing lesson topics.
Option-length issues flagged for manual edits.
Final checklist items prepared for publication review.

best_practices: Provide complete chapter notes and lesson titles before generation.
Review every explanation for accuracy after answer redistribution.
Keep option lengths close to reduce guessing bias.
anti_patterns: Using the skill for short recall-only quizzes.
Running redistribution on important files without a backup.
Skipping source attribution or final syntax checks.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates 50-question interactive quiz files for a Quiz component.

faq.question: Does it support plain Markdown quizzes?
faq.answer: No. It is designed for Quiz component output, not static Markdown lists.

faq.question: Can it balance answer choices?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance and scripts that redistribute correct answer indexes.

faq.question: Does it create explanations?
faq.answer: Yes. It asks for detailed feedback that explains correct and incorrect options.

faq.question: Do I need to review the output?
faq.answer: Yes. Review option lengths, explanation accuracy, and JSX syntax before publishing.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: It declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
